passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: Ministry of Woman and Child Development (MWCD) is inviting applications from women students/ scholars/ social activists/ teachers enrolled in/ associated with any university/ academic/ non-academic institution under ‘Internship Programmes of the Ministry.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: The internship programme will be offered in four distinct terms throughout the financial year: May-June, August-September, November-December, and February- March, each with a duration of two months.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development
source.locator: department.txt; III. Schedule/Duration of the Internship

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: Prospective interns are required to submit their applications online on the Internship Programme portal http://wcd.intern.nic.in/ The applications can be submitted two months prior to the start of the internship, between 1st and 10th of the month (e.g. 1st -10th March for May-June, 1st -10th June for August-September etc.). Any candidate once selected for the internship shall not be eligible to apply for any subsequent term.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: Each intern would be provided a lump sum stipend of ₹20,000/- per month and reimbursement of travel cost (by Deluxe/AC Bus/3 Tier AC Train) for joining of the programme in the Ministry and return back home at the end of the programme.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: Interns proceeding on tour as part of the programme would be reimbursed travel cost (by Deluxe/AC Bus/3 Tier AC Train) and DA as per extant Government of India rates.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: The interns would also be awarded a certificate on successful completion of the programme on terms such as submission/presentation of papers/reports of the work done.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: Interns would be provided a hostel facility on a sharing basis for the duration of their programme in Delhi. The hostel facility will only include basic amenities like triple sharing accommodation in each room with an attached bathroom, bed (mattress is not included), table, chair and cupboard.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: Note: Mess charges are not included as part of the accommodation and are to be borne by the intern availing the hostel facility

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development
source.locator: myScheme page; Benefits, mess charges note

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: The women students, scholars, social activists and teachers from non-tier-I cities and rural parts of India will be eligible for the programme.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: The age of the applicant should be between 21 to 40 years.

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text: Interns can select any of the 2-month batches while submitting their applications

source.publisher: Ministry of Women and Child Development

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text:
Applicant have to visit the official portal.
Click on the Register button, from the top menu.
Provide the below required details.
Name
Date of Birth
Gender
State
District
City
E-Mail
Mobile No
Password and Confirm Password with Captcha Code.
Click on Register.

passages.scheme_name: Internship Programme for Women Students / Scholars / Social Activists / Teachers
passages.text:
Applicant have to visit the official portal.
Click on the Login button, from the top menu.
Use the email address and password used at the time of registration for logging in.
Applicants are required to upload latest password size photograph by updating profile.
Fill the application form and submit.
